# rx4u

> A lightweight, pure functional reactive programming library for JavaScript and TypeScript.

rx4u is inspired by RxJS but uses plain functions instead of Observable classes. Streams and operators are functions that can be composed with pipeFrom.

## English Documentation

- [Home](https://rx4u.dev/en-US): Overview of rx4u and functional reactive programming.
- [Getting Started](https://rx4u.dev/en-US/docs/getting-started): Installation and first reactive stream.
- [Core Concepts](https://rx4u.dev/en-US/docs/core-concepts): Streams, operators, subscriptions, and composition.
- [Operators](https://rx4u.dev/en-US/docs/operators): Operators for transforming, filtering, combining, and controlling streams.
- [API Reference](https://rx4u.dev/en-US/api-reference): Complete reference for operators, creation functions, and utilities.
- [Examples](https://rx4u.dev/en-US/examples): Practical rx4u examples and reactive programming patterns.
- [Playground](https://rx4u.dev/en-US/playground): Browser-based environment for experimenting with rx4u examples.
